_note: The campaign's numbers (Game Design's docs/design/campaign.md; sim/core/campaign.gd; docs/architecture/campaign-core.md). Campaign-only: no versus match reads this file, and no fighter reads anything of the campaign (Legal mc01, mc06). The route's numbers (sites a column, the flight band, the turns, the wear's bands) are World's, in data/biomes/campaign.json.
_enabled: the campaign's one switch: the campaign's host builds episodes, asks World for columns and keeps the season record only while it is on. data/biomes/campaign.json's own enabled is read by World's tools only
_columns: an episode's stages, each a column of the route: the cold open, the rise, the twist, the escalation and the climax (campaign.md 2.2)
_crossBack: the cross-back (campaign.md 2.2): column `from`'s untaken named place is asked of World again at column `to` (WorldCampaign.column's prefer); World offers it, leading the sites, when it stands in the band of a ring
_sideShare: thousandths: a main-story episode won offers a side story on about this share of them (campaign.md 1.4: about half, a first value); World then places it, or none is offered when no place is in reach
_arcEpisodes: a filler arc's episodes: the pilot, the middle and the finale (campaign.md 2.1)
_families: Narrative's filler families (docs/narrative/filler-templates.md filler_kind): a filler arc's first two episodes take two different ones by the arc's seed
_ringCols: the episode's first ring, round the player's home, in columns (Half: a column's places lie 322 to 806 columns from the pair each way, which a Half ring fits well; Game Design's rulings-2026-10-26 item 1)
